label: late original-phase steps (t>=5), gated by current-token / first-token identity
explanation: Fires only during the original (input) phase from about step 4 on, and weakly at the <DEL> step (6% of mass). It never fires at t<=2 or anywhere in the copy phase. The rate rises with orig_idx (0.6% at idx 3, about 45-49% at idx 7-8) and is highest on the last 1-3 inputs before <DEL> (to_go<=2 holds 87% of mass). Longer sequences carry more mass. Within that window it depends on token identity. It is more likely on the current input x, i, l, h, 1, c, v, d (x is 3x lift), on first occurrences (in_first, 86% of mass), and in sequences whose first token is k, j, t, p, g, a, e or r. It is suppressed on current tokens such as o and u. The top activations (about 0.1) mostly sit on x/l near the end of 8-9 token inputs that start with k, t, j or e. The predicate gives dev F1 0.61 and mass recall 0.83. The coordinate looks like a distributed mix of position and token code rather than one crisp concept, and precision is limited because many late-position steps with the listed tokens stay below threshold.
